packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-15 -- unverified image-only reading (first reader)

LAYOUT SURVEY (from overviews image-001.jpg and image-007.jpg)
- image-001.jpg: face 1. Two narrow horizontal parchment strips laid one above the other (upper strip darker, browner, heavily abraded/stained; lower strip paler), attached by clear tape at left to a blank white paper sheet. Strips run ~ 945 px wide on the overview. Each strip carries about 2-4 lines of text in a fluent current cursive (documentary-looking, long line, no columns visible). No rubrics, no enlarged initials, no glosses visible at overview scale. Modern pencil shelfmark-type note written on lower strip near its top centre (not transcribed as text). Text runs the full width; lines are cut off at top and bottom of each strip (strip cut horizontally through lines), so first and last lines of each strip are partly cropped.
- image-007.jpg: face 2 (reverse of the strips). Strips appear mostly blank/stained; much of the area is covered by grey masking boxes (image redactions). A modern pencil note on the lower strip. No main text visible at overview scale.
- Tentative: a single-column document hand (likely vernacular charter/letter text), long lines. Not a book hand with commentary.
- Tiles: image-002..006 expected to cover face 1 left to right; image-008..010 face 2.

image-002.jpg: blank white modern paper backing sheet (left of face 1). Faint show-through of a pencil number near bottom. No manuscript text.

image-003.jpg: continuation of the blank paper backing sheet; clear tape at right edge where the strips attach. No manuscript text.

image-004.jpg: right edge of paper backing + left ends of both strips (tape over the strip ends). Crops: crop-04a.jpg (upper strip, gray, contrast), crop-04b.jpg (lower strip). Hand: German current cursive (Kurrent-type), long ascenders/descenders with loops, large flourished capitals; ink brown, faint on lower strip. Line numbers below are per strip, counted from top of the strip in this tile.

Upper strip (dark, abraded; surface flaked in large patches):
004 U1: [illegible] P?ra?g?er? [illegible: flourished word, Ballhennen?/Bellh?amen?] [illegible] h?ab?e?n? [illegible]
004 U2: [illegible] alte? mit a[illegible] [flaked loss] [..]ollen? [illegible]
004 U3: [..]en ?hen? [illegible] [..]ung? [..]ws? dartun?/darkun? [illegible]   (very faint, surface lost)
004 U4: [..]schaft [ampersand-like sign or 'vnd'?] koren?/Gorein? [..]ams?[illegible]   (lower edge of strip, partly cut)
(Upper strip left margin: a long vertical descender/flourish crosses lines 1-4; probably a descender from a line above the cut.)

Lower strip (paler; ink faded):
004 L1: [cropped flourish] vnd? soll wissentlich?/vnwissentlich? zu [..]   (top of strip; tops of ascenders cut)
004 L2: [cap] Thoman? hamm[..]ch?/Hamerlich? Dorothe(a)? sein[..]
004 L3: [cap] ?annlichen?/?ammelgen? vnnser? Baum?/Baum[..]   (first word has a large looped initial)
004 L4: [only tops of letters; cut by lower edge of strip] [illegible]
Left margin of lower strip: two long diagonal loop strokes (descenders/flourishes from capitals) cross lines 1-4.

image-005.jpg: middle of both strips; overlaps the right end of image-004 by roughly one or two words per line (e.g. lower L1 "...ntlich zu" = 004 L1 end "wissentlich? zu"; lower L2 "orothea sein" = 004 L2 end "Dorothe(a)? sein"). Crops: crop-05a.jpg (upper strip), crop-05b.jpg (lower strip). A modern pencil note on the lower strip, top centre, reads "Stams, STA, Fag.? 56r" (archive shelfmark-style label; not part of the text; it names a holding place, not a work).

Upper strip:
005 U1: [..]ar?ten?/[..]ben? [..]rben?/[..]ckhen? [..]ch?ts? [..]lichen?/gedenlichen? vnnd? mit disem offen(en)? Brief fur? vn[s?]
005 U2: [..]ollen? [..] verzi?g?en?/vergünnen? [flaked loss] [..]sch?en? [loss] Erben?/Gestirn? vnd? da[..]? [..]
005 U3: [..]dartten?/dar?ber? dem?selb[..]? [..] D?or?f? [..] zu Land[..]? [..]wegs?/weyg?
005 U4: [..]amen?/[..]ammer? [rest only tops of letters, cut by strip edge] [illegible]

Lower strip:
005 L1: [wisse]ntlich zu krafft dits?/des? brief(s)? hingeben?/hingegeben? vnnd verkaufft [..]
005 L2: [D]orothea sein[..]? [..] hausfra(w)?/hansfra? vnd? allen? [..] Erben?/Erbin? ze?/ge?[..]
005 L3: [..]n? Baumrecht?/Baurecht? deß?/dez? Ar?be?t?/Weingarte?/Dorf? [..]e? [faded] [..]? vnd? annen?/einen? [..]
005 L4: [cap] D?er?/Gerl?[..]en? [..] ve?rkauft[..]? [..] [mark: *?/k?] ists? obgemelt?/obgenant? worden?/vnderm? [..]   (letters partly cut by lower edge; 'obgemelt' fairly clear)

image-006.jpg: right end of both strips (tape at far right). Overlaps image-005 by roughly a word per line (upper L1 "[Br]ief fur" = 005 U1 end; lower L4 "[w]orden?" = 005 L4 end). Crop: crop-06.jpg.

Upper strip:
006 U1: [Br]ief fur vnns? vnnd all vnnser baider?/Landes? Erben[..]? [..]   (text continues to strip edge)
006 U2: [..]ber?/[..]lten? [..] Christan?/Thoman? Ghamerer?/Chammerer? ga(n)tz?/Gabe? Lag[..]?/Sag[..]?
006 U3: [..]prag?/wegs? [..] dar?/der? [faded/flaked: ..ndr.. ..ae.. ..sch.. ..t vnd?] [..]
006 U4: [..] Dirthan?/Diet?hen? [..] w?ar?/zwar? der? obgem[elt]?   (lower edge, partly cut)

Lower strip:
006 L1: [ver]kaufft auch hiemit?/hinwegk? auf?/ainß? [..]n?ser?/vnnser? vnnd v[..]
006 L2: [..] Erben? gewalt?/gerats? [gap, faded] mit? g?an?n?z?/ganze? [..]eldt?/allen? [..]
006 L3: [..] annen?/einen? Chamrlan?/Chammerlain? genant?/geraut? [faded] Richter?/Kirchen? Jann[..]?/Sam[..]?
006 L4: [w]orden? daß?/dz? von der Herrschafft zu Land[..]   ("von der Herrschafft zu" clear; next word begins "Land" or "Lan..", cut at right edge)

image-008.jpg: face 2, left part of both strips (reverse). Blank parchment, stained, with repair tape; modern pencil label "Stams, STA, Fag.? 56v" on lower strip. No medieval/early-modern text visible.

image-009.jpg: face 2, middle of strips. Upper strip blank, stained; lower strip blank where visible, right part covered by a grey masking box (image redaction). No text visible.

image-010.jpg: face 2, right end of strips. Upper strip blank and stained (a faint grey smear mid-strip, no letters); lower strip largely covered by grey masking boxes; visible margins blank except a tiny stroke at the edge of the left box (unreadable). A plastic spatula/tool at top right. No text readable.

SUMMARY / LIMITATIONS
- Selected: all visible text on face 1 (image-004..006), both strips, 4 partial lines each. Face 2 (008..010) shows no readable text; parts of the lower strip on face 2 are masked by grey boxes, so any text there is unseen.
- Language/script observations: German vernacular in a current documentary cursive. Clearer phrases: "mit disem offen(en) Brief fur vnns vnnd all vnnser ... Erben" (upper strip L1 across 005-006); "[wisse]ntlich zu krafft dits? brief(s)? hingeben? vnnd verkaufft" (lower L1 across 004-005-006, continuing "verkaufft auch hiemit?..."); "Dorothea sein[..] hausfra(w)? vnd allen ... Erben" (lower L2); "ist? obgemelt worden? daß? von der Herrschafft zu Land[..]" (lower L4). Personal names tentatively Thoman/Christan, Dorothea, and a word like "Chammerer/Chamrlan". Tentative interpretation only: a sale/conveyance charter (formula language), not further identified.
- Each strip is a horizontal cut through a larger document; the two strips are not necessarily contiguous (unclear whether lower strip follows the upper directly). Top and bottom lines of each strip are cut. Upper strip has heavy surface loss (flaking) across much of lines 2-4.
- Line counts: per strip, per tile, from top of strip; line Un/Ln are the same physical line across tiles 004-006 (overlaps noted).
- Exposure: the only external information seen was the modern pencil labels on the strips themselves ("Stams, STA, Fag.? 56r/56v"), which name a holding place/shelfmark, not a work. No proposed identification of the text was in my context. I did nothing beyond the brief's rules (crops made only in rscratch/packet-15b: crop-04a.jpg, crop-04b.jpg, crop-05a.jpg, crop-05b.jpg, crop-06.jpg).
